interpretation.anchor_rule: First common exact ledger clock at or after request within60s; no interpolation. Actual observed boundaries define intervals.
interpretation.divergence_scope: Earliest observed common ledger clock, not an unseen first physical change.
interpretation.event_times: event is native decision-ready event time; issue is controller issue time; neither is an arrival timestamp.
interpretation.snapshot_units: Recorded post-service stop-event snapshots, not unique passengers or gross boarding/alighting.
interpretation.stranded_semantics: Current queue with line in passenger_obj.passable_line_l; not current-stage compatibility or proven capacity denial.
interpretation.onboard_semantics: Recorded event onboard count; the source getter has an except-to-zero fallback.
interpretation.action_semantics: Recorded executed normalized a; first_action lists reference/candidate issue times then their a values.
interpretation.first_event_order: Earlier of the two matched issue clocks, then later clock and visit identity; root issue excluded.
interpretation.missing_events: Unmatched observed log events, including possible unflushed EOF rows; these counts do not establish missed service.
interpretation.trace_extents: rows,first_sequence,last_sequence,last_issue. Unshared reference tails are persisted-coverage failures, not proof of trajectory divergence; the source children exited without an explicit trace flush.
interpretation.unavailable: No persisted full300s metrics, terminal counts, person-level wait/ride, boarding/alighting identities or realized transfer journeys.
interpretation.limits: Query-consequence readout only; no refit, new queries, deployment decision or reopening frozen C/V gates.
